# notion-db-sync

> Pull a Notion database into local Markdown files with front matter: incremental by last edit time, deletions mirrored and local edits detected as conflicts, never overwritten Python package `trysac-notion-db-sync`, import name `notion_db_sync`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
